articles.content: COrigami — Tom Zahavy Tom Zahavy Home Publications About Blog ← Home COrigami Combines reinforcement learning with Gemini to design origami crease patterns, using a semantic representation and visual feedback loop to fold arbitrary target shapes. Paper ↗ Crease Patterns ↓ Designed with COrigami, shaped and folded by Brandon Wong. Origami is a uniquely constrained art form: every design must obey the mathematics of flat-foldability while still looking like the thing it depicts. COrigami is an end-to-end AI pipeline that tackles both at once, turning a natural-language prompt into a crease pattern that genuinely folds.
